background_image_description: Subtle vintage paper texture covering the entire 1600x1200 canvas: light cream base with scattered irregular speckles and smudges in muted beige and tan, low contrast, giving a lightly worn, printed poster feel.

nodes.asset_description: Retro cartoon character on the right: a bright yellow circular face/head outlined in dark forest green with a friendly smile. Two tall black oval eyes with large white highlights tilt inward. A red oval nose sits centered above a thin curved smile line. Rubber-hose style dark green arms and legs, each ending in oversized white gloves and chunky dark green shoes with white midsoles/outsoles. Character is mid-walk, left foot forward, right foot back, arms swinging opposite the legs. Small curved accent lines on the head show eyebrow arches and a cheek highlight. A flattened dark green oval shadow sits beneath the shoes. Overall style is vintage 1930s cartoon with clean fills and bold outlines.
